question: Which film won the Best Film award at the 25th IIFA Awards held in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laapataa Ladies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **25th edition** of the **International Indian Film Academy (IIFA) Awards** was held in **March 2025** in **Jaipur, Rajasthan**.
 
• The film **Laapataa Ladies** emerged as the big winner, securing the **Best Picture** (Best Film) award.
 
• The movie was directed by **Kiran Rao** and produced by **Aamir Khan Productions** and **Kindling Pictures**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Laapataa Ladies.***
 
• The ceremony marked the **Silver Jubilee** of the IIFA Awards, celebrating 25 years of honoring excellence in **Bollywood**.
 
• The film **Laapataa Ladies** was also India's official entry for the **97th Academy Awards (Oscars 2025)** in the **Best Foreign Language Film** category, which significantly boosted its profile at domestic award shows.
 
• **Kiran Rao** also received the **Best Director** award at the **25th IIFA** for her work on this film, highlighting its critical and artistic success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Indian Film Academy (IIFA) Awards:**

 
 
• The **IIFA Awards** were established in the year **2000** to promote Indian cinema globally.
 
• The first-ever ceremony was held at the **Millennium Dome** in **London**.
 
• Since its inception, the event has been hosted in various countries across **Europe, Asia, Africa, and North America** to expand the reach of Indian films.
 
 
 
• **About Laapataa Ladies:**
 
 
• The film is a **social satire** set in rural India in **2001**, focusing on the story of two brides who get swapped during a train journey.
 
• It stars young actors **Nitanshi Goel**, **Pratibha Ranta**, and **Sparsh Shrivastava**, along with seasoned actor **Ravi Kishan** in a pivotal role.
 
• The movie was released in **March 2024** and received widespread acclaim for its screenplay, humor, and feminist themes.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees in the Category:**
 
 
• Films like **Animal**, **Stree 2**, **12th Fail**, and **Article 370** were among the major competitors for various categories during the 2024-2025 awards season.
 
• **Stree 2**, featuring **Shraddha Kapoor** and **Rajkummar Rao**, was one of the highest-grossing films of the year, while **Article 370** was noted for its political narrative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Venue Significance:** Hosting the **25th IIFA** in **Jaipur** was a significant move to bring the "Silver Jubilee" celebration back to **India** after several years of international venues like **Abu Dhabi** and **Bangkok**.
 
• **Award Categories:** IIFA covers various technical and creative categories including **Best Actor**, **Best Actress**, **Best Supporting Role**, and **Technical Excellence** (Editing, Cinematography, etc.).
 
• **Impact of 12th Fail:** While **12th Fail** (directed by **Vidhu Vinod Chopra**) won several awards at the **Filmfare** and **National Film Awards**, **Laapataa Ladies** dominated the IIFA 2025 platform.
 
• **Global Reach:** The IIFA awards are managed by **Wizcraft International** and play a key role in the **soft power** of India's cultural export.
